concept.name: Data cleaning
concept.definition: The documented process of detecting and handling invalid, inconsistent, duplicate, missing, or mistimed observations before analysis.
concept.intuition: It controls what information the model receives and in what numerical representation.
concept.mechanics: Define rules from domain knowledge, preserve raw data and audit flags, fit statistical thresholds on training data, and test the effect of each correction.
concept.failure_modes: Fitting the operation on the full dataset leaks future information; revisions, outliers, and missing values can also distort results.
concept.misconceptions: A cleaner or rescaled dataset is not automatically more truthful; transformations must preserve timing and economic meaning.
concept.example: A negative share volume is flagged invalid and set missing rather than silently converted to a positive number.
